description: This script manages mounting and unmounting of block devices in response to udev events, automating mounting processes and handling various device and filesystem types based on system state and configuration.

methods.name: automount_systemd
methods.description: Handles auto-mounting of devices using systemd-mount, checking if the device is already mounted, and performing the mount if not.

methods.name: automount
methods.description: Performs auto-mounting using either pmount or mount, validating devices, and managing mount points.

methods.name: rm_dir
methods.description: Removes a directory if it is empty or only contains the mount point, with safety checks.

methods.name: get_label_name
methods.description: Retrieves the label or partition label of a device to name the mount point accordingly.
